title: wolfHSM double-eviction on C_GenerateKeyPair then C_DestroyObject
description: C_GenerateKeyPair produces two wp11_wolfhsm_key_priv_t structs (pub + priv) that share the same key_id and both have generated_here=1. Destroying both objects calls hsm_free_key_priv twice, which calls wh_Client_KeyEvict twice on the same key_id. The second evict is semantically wrong (key already evicted) and may produce an error that is silently ignored. Fix: only one side (priv) should own the eviction.
